title: 12 Best Craft Beer Bars in Tokyo
description: Discover Tokyo's top craft beer bars, from hidden gems to iconic brewpubs. Explore 12 must-visit venues with local tips, prices, and what to order for an unforgettable experience.

places.name: Popeye
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A tasting flight of local Japanese IPAs and the famous 'Popeye Salad' with their homemade dressing.

places.name: Beer-ma Kanda
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Any new or limited-release IPA on tap, and browse their extensive bottle selection for unique finds to take home.

places.name: T.Y. Harbor Brewery
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Pale Ale' or 'Wheat Ale' and the signature 'T.Y. Harbor Burger' or oven-fired pizza.

places.name: DevilCraft Brewery (Hamamatsucho)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A 'Deep Dish Pizza' (allow 45-60 min cooking time) paired with one of their hop-forward 'IPAs' or a 'Belgian-style Ale'.

places.name: Goodbeer Faucets
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A flight of various Japanese craft beers and the 'Smoked Salmon Carpaccio' or 'Fish and Chips'.

places.name: Baird Beer Taproom Harajuku
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A pint of 'Rising Sun Pale Ale' or 'Teikoku IPA' and the 'Fish and Chips' or 'Baird Burger'.

places.name: Craft Beer Market (Kanda)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A variety of smaller pours (e.g., half pints) to try more beers, and share some 'Karaage' (fried chicken) or 'Gyoza'.

places.name: Antenna America (Shinagawa)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A flight showcasing different West Coast IPAs or a rare sour beer, paired with some 'Spicy Chicken Wings'.

places.name: Tap Stand
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A pint of whatever 'Seasonal Lager' or 'Pale Ale' is on tap, and a quick snack like 'Edamame' or 'Fried Potatoes'.

places.name: Barley Harvest Season
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ask the bartender for a recommendation based on your taste, especially for a 'regional Japanese Stout' or 'Saison'.

places.name: Vector Beer (Shinjuku)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order One of their rotating 'Hoppy IPAs' and a platter of 'Assorted Sausages' or 'Grilled Skewers'.

places.name: Swan Lake Pub Edo (Tokyo Station)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Koshibu Apple Lager' or 'Porter' from Swan Lake Brewery, accompanied by a 'Cheese Platter' or 'Fried Chicken'.
